$doc: Document 38 §6/§8 executable L2 program: L2_N (all generations normal-realistic) versus L2_EN (early generations triage under EASY evidence, then a MANDATORY re-evaluation of every surviving elite under normal-realistic conditions before any champion, migration, archive or release eligibility). L1 is FROZEN for both arms at the section-15/16 result: phase-1 dynamics normal_realistic, phase-1 LR 3e-5, phase-2 LR 3e-5. Both arms receive an identical total candidate-evaluation budget, identical population size, identical population seed, identical initial genome seeds, the identical frozen L1 recipe, the identical nested data roles and identical normal-realistic decision evidence. Easy and normal scores never share one comparable leaderboard: the stage transition INVALIDATES easy fitness and the runner refuses any promotion path that carries an easy-evaluated entry.
question: Does an ordered easy->normal L2 SEARCH curriculum improve the evolved configuration genome over an all-normal L2 search, at equal candidate-evaluation budget and a frozen L1 recipe?

nested_split_contract.$doc: Doc 38 §3 / finding 224: the EXECUTING pipeline consumes this typed nested contract directly, in nested_split_mode=l2. role_facts are ASSERTIONS the runner verifies against freshly materialized per-role CSVs BEFORE any model construction. sealed_test (2025) is NEVER materialized: no CSV path, hash, row load or evaluation may exist outside mode=release.

role_use.fit_train: candidate gradient updates only (11509 scored rows)
role_use.train_monitor: L1 in-sample stopping member inside each candidate (2190 scored rows, 2022)
role_use.inner_validation: L1 stopping member AND first member of the L2 paired comparator (2190 scored rows, 2023)
role_use.outer_validation: second member of the L2 paired comparator; L2 selection/confirmation, never fitted (2196 scored rows, 2024)
role_use.sealed_test: SEALED - no CSV path, hash, row load or model evaluation may be emitted (2025)

observation_contract.$doc: AUD-P1LR-20260815-235. The observation fields EVERY L2 candidate runs under, bound onto the materialized runtime config before any env or model is constructed (pipeline_plugins._observation_contract.apply_observation_contract) and then enforced by the pre-existing fail-closed validator (validate_observation_contract). Until now that validator was OPT-IN and defaulted OFF, so it returned on its first line and validated nothing: the base config examples/results/project3_ethusdt_4h_sac_train_val_test_v2/config_out.json declares include_price_window=true and no require_feature_aware_preprocessor, which injected 64 UNNORMALIZED dimensions (32 raw ETH closes, mean |value| ~1742, plus their 32 raw diffs) into an otherwise rolling-z-scored, +-10-clipped observation. Those 64 dimensions fix the sign of most first-layer pre-activations at the always-positive price level, so ~half the actor's first-layer ReLUs are dead for EVERY observation from initialization and the survivors saturate tanh into a constant action. A dead ReLU has exactly zero gradient: no learning rate and no epoch budget can recover it, which is why phase-1 LR 1e-4 and 3e-5 collapsed identically.
observation_contract.$feature_columns: 83 ordered, deduplicated engineered columns declared by the held-fixed base config; the sha256 above pins that exact ordered list (sha256 of the compact JSON array of column names) so this contract refuses to bind onto a different feature set.
observation_contract.$observation_dimension: window_size*len(feature_columns) + include_agent_state*4 = 32*83 + 4 = 2660. The superseded price-window observation was 2724 = 2660 + 32 raw closes + 32 raw diffs.
observation_contract.$consequence_for_the_frozen_anchor: BLOCKING for dispatch: frozen_l1_recipe.common_anchor (anchor_seed101.zip) was trained under the 2724-dim price-window observation, so its actor.latent_pi.0 weight has 2724 input columns and it CANNOT warm-start a 2660-dim candidate. agent_plugins.sac_agent supports observation EXPANSION only; contraction is not supported and would in any case carry the dead first layer forward. A replacement anchor must be produced under this observation contract, or candidate_initialization must move off frozen_common_anchor, before the L2 decision run is dispatched. This contract does NOT make that scientific choice.
observation_contract.$how_it_reaches_a_candidate: REQUIRED RUNNER BINDING, one line, inside materialize_candidate_config in tools/l2_curriculum_arms.py, next to the other contract bindings: config['observation_contract'] = contract['observation_contract']. pipeline_plugins._observation_contract.apply_observation_contract then binds these fields onto the runtime config before any env or model is constructed, and validate_observation_contract enforces them. WITHOUT that line the candidate config carries no declaration (evaluate_candidate pops _identity before the pipeline sees the config) and the now fail-closed validator REFUSES with UNDECLARED_OBSERVATION_CONTRACT. That refusal is the SAFE state: the campaign stops instead of silently training on the raw price window, which is exactly what happened for three experiments while the validator was opt-in and defaulted OFF.

frozen_l1_recipe.$doc: Order 2026-08-15 §2 requirement 1: L1 is FROZEN for every L2 arm. These values are byte-identical in every generation of BOTH arms; no L1 curriculum field may appear in the L2 gene space (l1_frozen_gene_names below is the refusal list).

common_anchor.$doc: ONE frozen anchor shared by every candidate of BOTH arms. It is part of the frozen L1 recipe, never a per-genome inheritance: a genome that names its own anchor, weights, topology or replay buffer is refused (requirement 4).

l2_stage_difficulty_binding.$doc: How a stage's declared difficulty reaches the executable candidate. evidence_only_v1: the stage difficulty binds the SOLVENCY MODE OF THE CANDIDATE'S TRIAGE EVIDENCE only; training stays on the frozen L1 recipe (phase-1 dynamics normal_realistic) so requirement 1 holds literally. training_and_evidence_v1 would additionally move the candidate's phase-1 dynamics, which IS an L1 curriculum field and is therefore refused unless l1_freeze_exception_approved is explicitly true.

shared.$doc: Requirement 3: IDENTICAL across both arms. assert_arms_identical_budget refuses any divergence in these fields or in the per-arm ledger derived from the stage schedules.
shared.gene_space_source: agent_plugins/sac_agent.py hparam_schema() minus every l1_frozen_gene_name (learning_rate is the frozen phase-2 LR and can never be a gene)

candidate_budget_knobs.$doc: Per-candidate L1 budget, identical in both arms. 1 phase-1 pass-equivalent + at most 24 phase-2 pass-equivalents at the ladder 20000-step pass budget.

stage_schedules.$doc: Doc 38 §8 ordered L2 search stages crossed with the arm's difficulty schedule. reevaluation stages are NOT search generations: they spend exactly population_size evaluations re-scoring every carried elite under normal-realistic evidence. Both ledgers total shared.total_candidate_evaluations.

l2_stopping.$doc: Requirement 5: L2 patience uses the PAIRED inner/outer comparator after a minimum generation floor. Reused implementation: pipeline_plugins._paired_generalization.PairedStoppingState.

diversity.$doc: Requirement 6: every generation record must carry these fields so apparent convergence is never confused with collapse.

workers.$doc: Requirement 9: SEQUENTIAL dispatch. All four workers collaborate on ONE chain of ONE arm at a time; the arm order is L2_N then L2_EN. Creating a second chain for the same arm is a typed refusal (REFUSED_PARALLEL_CHAIN).

smoke.$doc: Requirement 10: bounded mechanics smoke across the four physical GPUs. It proves imports, contracts, chain coherence, easy-fitness invalidation, mandatory re-evaluation, diversity logging and four-worker collaboration. It is EXCLUDED from every scientific aggregation (doc 38 §2 and §10 step 5).

decision.$doc: The full comparison. Dispatched only after the smoke passes; both arms run SEQUENTIALLY on one chain each, four workers per chain.

forbidden: resuming or warm-starting from the paused DOIN campaign eth-4h-anchored-full-sac-shared-v2 (HISTORICAL AND INVALID)
creating a second, parallel chain for one arm
letting an easy-evaluated candidate enter a normal leaderboard, champion, migration, archive or release path
inheriting SAC weights, replay buffers, optimizer moments or topology between L2 genomes
varying any l1_frozen_gene_name during the L2 comparison
materializing, hashing, loading or evaluating sealed_test (2025)
aggregating smoke records into any scientific collection

training or evaluating any L2 candidate on the unscaled raw price window (include_price_window=true), which drives the actor's first layer into the zero-gradient dead-ReLU regime (AUD-P1LR-20260815-235)
warm-starting an L2 candidate from an anchor trained under a different observation contract
